headline: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
context: In an exclusive interview with the BBC’s Steve Rosenberg, Dmitry Muratov says the Kremlin leader can only "destroy Ukraine, not conquer it", with the war now in its fifth year.
